name: DAX Robotics
summary: DAX Robotics is a Beijing robotics developer focused on mobile manipulation for retail, logistics, pharmacy handling and other repetitive work. The company develops a robot platform and an embodied world model together, and offers its X7 platform in research and commercial configurations. Its official product portfolio also includes a heavy-load quadruped platform. The company presents robot hardware, local inference and application deployment as an integrated system.
